_comment: The tabs that are shells until Eli writes them. Each becomes <slug>.html with the site's header, footer and heading, and one visible note in place of the body. Fill one in by replacing its "note" with a "body" array of paragraphs; the build will render those instead and drop the placeholder styling.

pages.title: About
pages.note: Two or three paragraphs in your own voice: what pulls you to a picture, how you work, what you are chasing at the moment.

pages.title: Education
pages.note: Courses, workshops and certificates, newest first. Name, where, and the year.

pages.title: Tips
pages.note: What you would tell someone picking up a camera this week. A handful of specifics beats a long list.

pages.title: Resume
pages.note: Shoots you have been paid or asked to do, shows, placements, awards, and anything a client would want to know. Newest first.

pages.title: AP Work
pages.note: Your sustained investigation: the question driving it, and the frames as they come. Send me the images and I will lay them out like the Biweekly page.
